newsitem.title: USA: Storage Technology vice president resigns.
newsitem.headline: Storage Technology vice president resigns.

text.p: Storage Technology Corp said on Wednesday that executive vice president of worldwide field operations John Williams had resigned.
The computer storage company said in a statement that Williams plans to leave the company after January of 1998 but will step aside from day-to-day management of field operations immediately.
No one was immediately available at Storage Technology to comment on reasons for Williams' resignation.
The company added that international field operations will be consolidated under Bruce Taafe, currently vice president of Asia/Pacific operations.
